description: This script automates the setup, schema creation, and seeding of a PostgreSQL database for the IndoLearn Flashcards project. It creates extensions, tables, inserts demo data, and initializes some quiz attempts and user progress.

methods.name: run_sql
methods.description: Helper function to execute a SQL statement with the specified psql command, stopping on error.

methods.description: Function to trim whitespace from a string, used to clean up query results.
